summary: All 40 genes in the published hypothalamus [Table 1B](https://academic.oup.com/toxsci/article/172/1/38/5545529) matched a unique registered effect and agreed in direction for SHAM ozone versus filtered air. Pearson was 0.976 and Spearman was 0.885, so the selected list passed only the directional criterion of author-concordance-v2. The proposal and evidence were saved and verified by offline replay.
openIssues: The public sources yielded rounded effects for 40 of 20,845 registered genes. The full author DESeq2 table, numeric per-gene P values and FDR, and exact model settings remain unavailable. Genome-wide agreement and full verification remain unassessed.
